children.innerHTML: Everything in Sidequest maps to something your team already does, minus the misery. Keep this manual near the cabinet.
Any teammate files a quest in one line. Templates load the details.
Who's on what, at a glance. No status meeting survives contact with this key.
Not now, not never. Snoozed quests respawn on the date you pick.
Closes the quest, awards XP, drafts the release note. The good button.
PRs close quests automatically. Merge = XP.
Ship announcements with your team's chosen victory sound.
Blocks new quests from landing on a teammate mid-boss.
Pair on any quest; XP is split evenly, friendship is not.
Entered by your admin, effective immediately:
Imports your entire Jira in under an hour. Yes, all of it. Yes, even that project.
Invites the whole team at once. Everyone starts at level 1; the intern will pass you by Thursday.

meta_description: Controls, power-ups and cheat codes: how Sidequest maps to the work your team already does.
